prompts.text: Use the two uploaded images as the base. They show the same person about ten years apart. The person in the first image is the younger version, from {then}: keep that face, facial features, skin tone, hair, age, body and the outfit from the first image exactly. The person in the second image is today's version: keep that face, facial features, skin tone, hair, age, body and the outfit from the second image exactly. Do not blend the two, do not swap their faces and do not make them the same age. An ordinary, unedited smartphone photo, taken by a friend at chest height. The place: {place}, a real, everyday place in natural light, with ordinary details and a little everyday clutter, like a snapshot from someone's camera roll. The younger version is on the left. {arrive_photo} The younger version looks fresh, curious and full of energy, and looks at today's version. A few steps away on the right, today's version looks tired, with slumped shoulders, holding a plain paper coffee cup and looking back at the younger version. Both from the knees up, both faces clear and sharp, turned three-quarters toward the camera. Photorealistic, natural skin and natural colors: no cinematic lighting, no color grading, no soft dreamy glow, no blurred bokeh background, not CGI, not a cartoon. Vertical 9:16. Exactly two people, nobody else close by. No flags, no signs, no name tags, no text, no logos, no watermarks.

prompts.text: An ordinary, unedited phone video filmed by a friend, in one continuous shot with no cuts, in natural light with a slight handheld shake, like a real clip on social media. Keep both faces, hair, ages and outfits exactly as in the image: the younger one on the left is the version from {then}, and the older one on the right is today's version of the same person. {arrive_video} The younger version looks around in wonder, walks up to today's version, looks them slowly up and down and says, confused: "{line1}" Today's version gives a tired shrug, lifts the coffee cup and says flatly: "{line2}" {ending} Only the younger version says the first line, and only today's version says the second one, every word clearly and exactly as written. Audio: the natural sound of the scene and the two spoken lines, and nothing else: no music. Exactly two people, no extra limbs, no morphing, no cinematic look, no slow motion, no text, no subtitles, no logos.
